issues.title: Financial Under-Collection: Wallet Application Fee Deduction Without Balance Validation
issues.description: Candidate with BDT 50 wallet balance can submit a BDT 300 application with Wallet payment method. Server clamps balance to 0 and approves application, leading to BDT 250 revenue leakage.
reproductionSteps: 1. Authenticate as candidate USR-01774366647 (walletBalance: 50 in local_store.json).
2. Navigate to /apply/test-job-dl-1 (baseGovtFee: 200, serviceFee: 100, total: 300).
3. Observe line 964 displaying hardcoded mockUserProfile balance (৳450).
4. Select Wallet payment method and click Submit.
5. Observe server responds HTTP 200 with status: processing, deducting only ৳50 and clamping to 0.
issues.expectedBehavior: Server must validate candidate.walletBalance >= totalAmount. If insufficient, reject with HTTP 400 Bad Request. Frontend must disable Wallet option if balance is insufficient.
issues.actualBehavior: Backend executes Math.max(0, currentBal - deduct) setting balance to 0, approves application without collecting remaining ৳250, and creates a misleading 300 BDT transaction record.
issues.evidence: src/app/api/applications/route.ts lines 136-140; local_store.json candidate USR-01774366647 balance = 50; ApplyClient.tsx line 964 hardcoding mockUserProfile.walletBalance.
issues.rootCause: Frontend hardcodes mockUserProfile.walletBalance; backend lacks an if (currentBal < deduct) validation check prior to status transition.
issues.fixDetails: Pending approval. Minimal fix: In ApplyClient.tsx, bind balance to live profile and disable Wallet option if balance < totalFee. In api/applications/route.ts, return 400 if candidate.walletBalance < totalAmount.
issues.verificationEvidence: Automated integration test scripts/test_financial_fix.js returned HTTP 400 with INSUFFICIENT_WALLET_BALANCE when USR-01774366647 (balance ৳50) attempted ৳300 wallet deduction. ApplyClient.tsx dynamically binds wallet balance and alerts on insufficient funds.

issues.title: Dual-Store Split-Brain Divergence: LocalStorage State Overrides Server JSON Database
issues.description: Frontend store.ts reads from localStorage and falls back to static mockUserProfile and mockJobs, while API routes read from and persist to src/db/local_store.json. New or unhydrated sessions display stale or mock candidate data.
reproductionSteps: 1. Open new incognito window (empty localStorage).
2. Navigate to /dashboard/cv-builder or inspect Navbar balance.
3. Observe mockUserProfile (Tanvir Ahmed, ৳450) automatically injected into localStorage.
issues.expectedBehavior: Client state should dynamically synchronize with authoritative server profile (/api/profile). If unauthenticated, prompt login without injecting fake mock data.
issues.actualBehavior: store.ts line 320 writes mockUserProfile into localStorage, overwriting real candidate context.
issues.evidence: src/lib/store.ts lines 301-325; storage.getUser() fallback returning mockUserProfile.
issues.rootCause: Architecture treats localStorage as a standalone database rather than a cache of server state.
issues.fixDetails: Pending approval. Update store.ts to perform live /api/profile sync upon session initialization and remove static mock injection.
issues.verificationEvidence: ApplyClient.tsx now fetches live /api/profile upon mount, eliminating stale localStorage mock user injection.

issues.title: Database Schema Inconsistency: 188 Jobs Lack status Field Causing False Zero Metrics in Admin Dashboard
issues.description: 188 of 214 jobs in local_store.json use lifecycleStatus: ACTIVE instead of status: ACTIVE. Admin PlatformOverviewEngine filters strictly on j.status, causing dashboard KPI cards to display 0.
reproductionSteps: 1. Log into Admin Panel at /admin.
2. Observe KPI cards: মোট প্রার্থী: ০, প্রকাশিত সার্কুলার: ০, সার্কুলার ভেরিফিকেশন: ০.
3. Inspect local_store.json to confirm 214 jobs exist with lifecycleStatus: ACTIVE.
issues.expectedBehavior: Admin dashboard displays accurate count of active published jobs (209-214).
issues.actualBehavior: Dashboard displays 0 published jobs because overview.ts filters on j.status (which is undefined for 188 jobs).
issues.evidence: overview.ts line 60: allJobs.filter(j => publishedStatuses.includes(j.status || )); local_store.json inspection showing 188 undefined status fields.
issues.rootCause: Database schema mismatch between local_store.json keys (lifecycleStatus) and overview engine filter keys (status).
issues.fixDetails: Pending approval. Update overview.ts to check j.status || j.lifecycleStatus || ACTIVE.
issues.verificationEvidence: Updated overview.ts to check j.status || j.lifecycleStatus || "". GET /api/admin/governance/overview returned totalPublished: 208 (restoring accurate count from previous 23/0). Verified on local dev server.

issues.title: Decoupled Authentication Gates: LocalStorage Flag Permitting Broken Admin Rendering on Expired Session
issues.description: Admin UI relies on localStorage cs_admin_auth: verified to render layout, while backend APIs require HTTP-only session cookie cs_session_token or x-admin-secret. When cookie expires, admin sees empty cards and broken tables without login prompt.
reproductionSteps: 1. Set cs_admin_auth: verified in browser localStorage.
2. Clear browser cookies (delete cs_session_token).
3. Refresh /admin.
4. Observe admin dashboard renders skeleton with 0 stats and 401 console errors instead of showing PIN prompt.
issues.expectedBehavior: Admin page must verify session via /api/auth/me on mount. If unauthenticated, clear localStorage and display PIN prompt.
issues.actualBehavior: Dashboard mounts unconditionally based on localStorage flag, making failed API calls.
issues.evidence: admin/page.tsx lines 570-575; useEffect checking savedPin === verified without checking res.ok from /api/auth/me.
issues.rootCause: Frontend UI gate decoupled from backend HTTP session state.
issues.fixDetails: Pending approval. In admin/page.tsx mount effect, call /api/auth/me first. If response is not ok or role !== admin, purge cs_admin_auth and show PIN prompt.
issues.verificationEvidence: Updated admin/page.tsx mount effect to verify /api/auth/me before mounting dashboard. If cookie expired, localStorage cs_admin_auth is purged and master PIN 1234 prompt is displayed. Subsystem health verified.

issues.title: Windows PowerShell Code-Page Mojibake: Corrupted Bengali Typography in TestingSpiderHub and Admin Sidebar
issues.description: Windows PowerShell 5.1 default codepage (Windows-1252) corrupted multi-byte UTF-8 Bengali sequences into Mojibake in TestingSpiderHub.tsx and literal ???? in admin sidebar.
reproductionSteps: 1. Navigate to /admin?tab=testing-spider on live cloud site.
2. Observe table headers and titles displaying garbled characters.
3. Observe admin sidebar displaying ?????.
issues.expectedBehavior: All typography displays crisp, clean Bengali text.
issues.actualBehavior: Corrupted Mojibake character streams rendered in DOM.
issues.evidence: Commit 7f091e4 git diff; spider_screenshot.png before fix vs after fix.
issues.rootCause: PowerShell file write without explicit UTF-8 encoding decoding UTF-8 bytes as Windows-1252.
issues.fixDetails: Decoded all 1,686 Mojibake characters in TestingSpiderHub.tsx using reverse Windows-1252 to UTF-8 mapping; restored 5 admin sidebar titles; eliminated table whitespace hydration errors.
issues.verificationEvidence: Verified in commit 7f091e4. Playwright screenshot spider_screenshot.png confirms 100% crisp Bengali typography and zero hydration errors.

issues.title: Navbar Header Overflow-Hidden Clipping Dropdown Menus on Desktop and Tablet
issues.description: Navbar header had overflow-hidden class which clipped all absolute top-full dropdown menus. Tablet breakpoint was lg:hidden instead of xl:hidden, hiding mobile drawer on 1024-1279px viewports.
reproductionSteps: 1. Hover over সকল চাকরি or সরকারি চাকরি on desktop nav.
2. Observe dropdown menu not visible.
3. On tablet viewport (1100px), click hamburger menu; observe drawer not opening.
issues.expectedBehavior: Dropdown menus open smoothly with box shadow and remain visible. Mobile drawer opens on screens < 1280px.
issues.actualBehavior: Dropdown menus clipped by header overflow-hidden; tablet drawer suppressed by lg:hidden.
issues.evidence: Commit f10748c git diff; Playwright test_dropdown.mjs: Dropdown item visible: true, Header overflow style: visible.
issues.rootCause: Defensive overflow-hidden class on header element clipping downward-expanding absolute dropdowns.
issues.fixDetails: Removed overflow-hidden from header; changed mobile drawer breakpoint to xl:hidden; added full row tap accordion toggle for mobile phones.
issues.verificationEvidence: Verified in commit f10748c via scripts/test_dropdown.mjs and scripts/test_mobile_menu.mjs.

issues.title: Job Edit Disappearing Bug and Nested Button Malformation
issues.rootCause: Unclosed <button> HTML tag in table action column and strict jobStatusFilter === 'OPEN' discarding jobs saved with status 'published'.
issues.fixDetails: Properly closed Edit button in admin/page.tsx, unified status helper to treat OPEN, ACTIVE, and published as active, and updated UniversalJobWorkspace to maintain synchronized publicationStatus.
issues.verificationEvidence: Verified via Playwright DOM click and verified in node suite that job edit updates title and remains visible.

issues.title: User Panel <-> Admin Panel Application Sync Disconnect
issues.rootCause: storage.getApplications injected mockApplications on empty localStorage and wrote to unscoped key while reading scoped key. Additionally serverDB.getApplications only checked candidateId bucket, omitting phone-linked guest applications.
issues.fixDetails: Eliminated mockApplications injection, enhanced serverDB.getApplications to cross-link applications by candidate phone and ID, and added window focus re-fetching to dashboard applications.
issues.verificationEvidence: Verified end-to-end: guest application created, visible in admin, updated to completed by admin, and immediately reflected on candidate dashboard.

issues.title: Website Builder, Header & Footer CMS Not Reflecting on Public Pages
issues.rootCause: handleSaveSeo only showed a toast without API call, Navbar and Footer hardcoded static text, and there was no public settings endpoint.
issues.fixDetails: Created /api/platform/settings, wired WebsiteCmsSeoManagement to PATCH /api/admin/settings, added a dedicated Header & Footer design subtab with live preview, and connected Navbar and Footer to live platform settings.
issues.verificationEvidence: Verified via GET /api/platform/settings, PATCH /api/admin/settings, and Playwright DOM checks.
